rotation_frequency.description: The frequency of log rotation (e.g., weekly, daily, monthly).

rotation_count.description: The number of weeks worth of backup logs to keep.

create_new_logs.description: Directive to create new empty log files after rotating old ones.

date_extension.description: Directive to use date as a suffix of the rotated file.

compress_logs.description: Directive to enable log file compression. Commented out in default config.
